exposure: advanced maternal age (>45 years at time of delivery)
cohort: 64 women >45 years old at delivery compared to 64 controls aged 20-30 years, matched for ethnicity, country of origin, and parity
finding: Older mothers (>45 years) were more likely to have cesarean sections, postpartum hemorrhage, and premature deliveries compared to younger controls.
mod_finding: Mothers >45 years had a fourfold increase in cesarean section compared to controls.
